anonymous-add-configurable-device-limit-.reason: On grafana main today, pkg/services/anonymous/anonimpl/anonstore/database.go updateDevice still does `args = append([]interface{}{query}, args...)` inside the WithDbSession callback and Exec(args...), and is still called from CreateOrUpdateDevice. sqlstore/session.go withDbSession still wraps the callback in retryer.Retry(ss.retryOnLocks(...)), which re-invokes the same callback on retryable lock errors. The file's later commits (#80028, Spanner/lint/test changes) did not touch this.
